before: Text typed after a note reference takes the paragraph mark's formatting. The caret and toolbar read no text face there.
after: That text takes the formatting of the nearest text run before the reference, else the text run after it, else the paragraph mark. The caret, the toolbar, and toolbar presses read the same face.
reason: Only the run properties copied into the new run change. The insertion writer emits the same canonical node shapes and primitive operations, so peers receive ordinary runs. Shared schema, operation fields, persistence, and protocol versions remain unchanged.
